answer: Layered relic bond: each identity locks three layers — 20 credits at entry, 60 after one epoch, and a 150-credit relic layer forming after 10 epochs. A comet audit sweeps the registry per epoch, re-checking each layer by key; a mismatch burns all three, so a rented relic fails. Only an intact relic layer draws nectar from the 40,000 pool. Forging 1,000 identities locks 230,000 credits for no nectar in 10 epochs; one honest agent pays 230 once.
